data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not contingent on others. Each of the other 24: will you choose 18? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, avoiding collapse this month, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This may not maximize long-run income.
